Bird Removal Services

Birds nesting in vents, soffits, chimneys or roof edges can leave behind nesting materials, droppings and blocked openings. Suburban Wildlife Solutions LLC provides bird removal services in Portland, CT that focus on identifying where birds are entering or roosting, removing them with appropriate methods, and helping homeowners reduce the chance of repeat activity. Our approach considers the species, the nesting situation and the condition of the property, and follows applicable wildlife regulations.

Nuisance Animal Control

Unwanted animals around the home can damage roofs, soffits, vents and attic spaces. Our nuisance animal control in Portland, CT starts with a careful inspection to identify the animal, its activity and the entry points it is using. Bat Exclusion

Bats can enter through small gaps around roofs, vents and exterior structures. Bat exclusion in Portland, CT is about more than removal: it means locating entry points, using humane exclusion techniques that prioritize bat safety, and sealing vulnerable openings to help prevent their return. Suburban Wildlife Solutions LLC also assesses attic concerns such as guano accumulation and disturbed insulation, and explains each step of the process.
